#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

vector<int> process(const string& s) {
    int maxLen = 0, wordCount = 0, curLen = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
            curLen = 0;
            i++;
            while (i < s.length() && s[i] != ')') {
                char ch = s[i];
                if (ch == '_') {
                    if (curLen > 0) { wordCount++; curLen = 0; }
                } else if (ch != '(' && ch != ')') {
                    curLen++;
                }
                i++;
            }
            if (curLen > 0) { wordCount++; curLen = 0; }
            i++;
        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
            curLen = 0;
            i++;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            i++;
        } else {
            curLen++;
            i++;
        }
    }
    if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
    return {maxLen, wordCount};
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    while (getline(cin, s)) {
        n = stoi(s);
        getline(cin, s);
        vector<int> res = process(s);
        cout << res[0] << " " << res[1] << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
